enforcement_note: Nothing verifies a doc was actually read or is still accurate. The PostToolUse nudge in handle_post_tool_use fires once per session when source changes without a doc change, which prompts but does not check. `--self-test` verifies frontmatter is present, not that the content is current.
rule: Load configured living docs and flag any missing frontmatter (provenance + version).
ai_action: Read each doc; flag missing frontmatter without blocking the session.
